reason: Seeds still bother me and the bookshelf has answers, so I will read before anything else, while the clay can wait for my paws to be empty.
The clay bank is wet and orange, and one piece of it is worth taking home to make something of.
One piece of clay becomes a small figure at the workbench, and I will keep it where I can see it.
Making things is tiring, and a patch of sun is the correct place to recover from it.
